rules.when: a worker runs on this runtime
rules.why: Gemini renders a trust dialog before any composer; no key may answer it, so a card is raised and the endpoint is closed instead. A plain Enter submits. Its idle composer shows only its path placeholder, which the shared shape reader treats as empty. A single Escape cancels the turn, and its own status row names that key. It does not restore the cancelled prompt, so no clear key is needed. A relaunch cannot resume an exact session, so it starts fresh. Gemini runs operator and Recon work only. While a turn runs the pane carries `esc to interrupt` with a rotating spinner word and an elapsed cell; idle it carries no elapsed cell. Busy is read from the lifecycle hooks, never from that footer.
